name: Chang Ch’iao
bio: Chang Ch’iao graduated at the government examinations about AD 870.
The poems here are Witter Bynner’s versions, from the texts of Kiang Kang-hu, in The Jade Mountain (1929).

poems.title: On the Border
poems.author: Chang Ch’iao
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
Though a bugle breaks the crystal air of autumn,
Soldiers, in the look-out, watch at ease today
The spring wind blowing across green graves
And the pale sun setting beyond Liang-chou.
For now, on grey plains done with war,
The border is open to travel again;
And Tartars can no more choose than rivers:
They are running, all of them, toward the south.
